tasks.title: Conversation #1
tasks.transcript:
WOMAN: The copier has been on the blink for a few days. I called you guys last week to come and take a look. What took you so long?
MAN: I'm terribly sorry, but some of our technicians have suddenly come down with terrible colds, and I have been terribly busy running around. Anyway, did you check and see if any paper is jammed inside?
WOMAN: Yes, that's the first thing I did, and that's not the problem. And it's not the toner either. I'm afraid the problem may be more serious.
MAN: All right. Let me take a look and see what the problem is.

questions.stem: When did the woman first make the call?
questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问女士首次报修的时间点，属于对过去具体时间的细节理解题，需从对话中提取明确的时间信息。 选项分析 选项A：正确。女士在对话开头明确说：“I called you guys last week to come and take a look”，直接对应“last week”，是原文原话的复现。 选项B：“A few days ago” 是文中提到“copier has been on the blink for a few days”的时间，描述的是故障持续时长，而非打电话的时间，属于混淆时间对象的干扰项。 选项C：“Yesterday” 在对话中未被提及，属于无中生有的错误选项。 选项D：“Today” 也不符合事实，因为女士抱怨“what took you so long”，说明维修人员今天才来，但电话是更早打的，属于将当前事件时间误作通话时间的干扰。

options.A: The weather has suddenly gotten very cold.
options.B: The man has come down with a cold.
options.D: The copier is not working properly.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问对话中核心问题是什么，属于主旨/事实识别题，需抓住整个对话围绕的中心事件。 选项分析 选项D：正确。整段对话围绕“copier has been on the blink”（复印机出故障）展开，女士已排除卡纸和碳粉问题，说明机器确实存在功能性故障，“not working properly”是对“on the blink”的准确同义转述。 选项A：“The weather has suddenly gotten very cold” 属于字面误解——文中“cold”指“感冒”（come down with colds），与天气无关，是典型的词汇歧义干扰项。 选项B：“The man has come down with a cold” 错误。文中说的是“some of our technicians”生病，并非这位维修男子本人，属于主语偷换的细节错误。 选项C：“Some important papers are missing” 完全未在对话中出现，女士只提到检查过是否“paper jammed”（卡纸），而非文件丢失，属于凭空捏造信息的干扰项。
